items.markdown:
A working capital loan `provides fast, short-term financing to cover everyday operating expenses like payroll, rent, and inventory` . Unlike long-term loans for fixed assets, it acts as a cash flow bridge. These loans can be secured or unsecured, and often disburse funds within 24 to 48 hours.[](https://www.fundingcircle.com/uk/businesses/working-capital-loans/) [[1]](https://www.fundingcircle.com/uk/businesses/working-capital-loans/)[[2]](https://ecapital.com/en-gb/blog/working-capital-loans-supporting-business-cash-flow-and-growth/)[[3]](https://www.novuna.co.uk/business-cash-flow/solutions/debt-financing/business-loans/working-capital-loans/)

How They Work

Working capital is the cash you need to run daily operations:  
W o r k i n g C a p i t a l=C u r r e n t A s s e t s−C u r r e n t L i a b i l i t i e s[](https://whiteoakuk.com/products/working-capital-loans/) [[1]](https://whiteoakuk.com/products/working-capital-loans/)[[2]](https://www.bajajfinserv.in/what-is-working-capital)

If a dip in revenue or a delayed invoice creates a shortfall, these loans provide liquidity. You borrow the funds and typically repay them in a few months to two years.[](https://www.iwoca.co.uk/finance-options/working-capital-loans) [[1]](https://www.iwoca.co.uk/finance-options/working-capital-loans)[[2]](https://whiteoakuk.com/products/working-capital-loans/)[[3]](https://www.jpmorgan.com/insights/banking/commercial-loans-and-lines-of-credit/working-capital-loans-how-they-work-and-help-your-business)[[4]](https://www.uswitch.com/business/business-loans/working-capital-loans/)[[5]](https://whiteoakuk.com/working-capital-loans-small-businesses/)

Common Formats

- **Term Loans:** A lump sum borrowed up-front, repaid with fixed monthly interest.
- **Lines of Credit:** A revolving facility where you draw, repay, and redraw funds as needed, paying interest only on what you use.
- **Invoice Financing:** Borrowing against your unpaid accounts receivable rather than taking on standard debt.[](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/what-is-working-capital-finance-and-how-does-it-work) [[1]](https://www.british-business-bank.co.uk/business-guidance/guidance-articles/finance/what-is-working-capital-finance-and-how-does-it-work)[[2]](https://www.fundingcircle.com/uk/businesses/working-capital-loans/)[[3]](https://ecapital.com/en-gb/blog/working-capital-loans-supporting-business-cash-flow-and-growth/)[[4]](https://www.jpmorgan.com/insights/banking/commercial-loans-and-lines-of-credit/working-capital-loans-how-they-work-and-help-your-business)[[5]](https://swoopfunding.com/us/business-loans/office-fit-out-finance/)

Eligibility & Options Approval is usually based on your business's overall financial health, credit score, and cash flow. Lenders range from traditional banks to alternative digital lenders:[](https://www.fundingcircle.com/uk/businesses/working-capital-loans/) [[1]](https://www.fundingcircle.com/uk/businesses/working-capital-loans/)[[2]](https://ecapital.com/en-gb/blog/working-capital-loans-supporting-business-cash-flow-and-growth/)[[3]](https://www.allica.bank/blog/working-capital-loan)

- **US/Global Providers:** Leading commercial institutions such as **[J.P.
